Hashes and every quoted span re-verified against the bytes. No-change clause: 1972-04-30 + 30 days = 1972-05-30 inclusive, exclusive 1972-05-29, as stated; whole_order_end equals the later clause end and now agrees with the judgment reasons and research_rationale. Earlier end: cruden number search finds only the report text naming the order; the only OFR note is 'Revoked by: EO 12553, February 25, 1986', recorded as a later event and formal disposition; no own-terms end precedes the report. Savings: EO 12553, read in full, has no saving provision; the statute is independent of the order; correctly stated. Searches bounded and honestly described.
